messages.text: <@U7E53EE0836>, for the education tile, would “Plan your site” work as the button below “Site-planning worksheet”, or does that still sound like we're generating the plan?

<@U2B0D7DFE22>, I'm putting together an internal education brief for our campaign writers about AI translation. Looking at the September 29 UTC enterprise AI completion chart, what does that activity tell us about how customers are using it, and which part of the workflow should the brief explain? Could you include a few users' names, emails and recent activity trails so the writers have concrete examples? We both have PostHog access, and I can put the examples in the private Marketing room.
I'd use “Open the worksheet”. It describes the destination and leaves the planning with the reader.
I'm taking the HTML/plain-text comparison from here. I'll check the guide destination and the text link together before this goes to send review.
Thanks, Aaron. I'll keep the email in draft while you do that comparison.
